# Contact method

contact_vis = False

# Simulation step sizes

tire_step_size = step_size

# Time interval between two render frames
render_step_size = 1.0 / 50  # FPS = 50

patch_mat.SetRestitution(0.01)

patch.SetTexture(veh.GetDataFile("terrain/textures/tile4.jpg"), 200, 200)
patch.SetColor(chrono.ChColor(0.8, 0.8, 0.5))

vis.SetWindowSize(1280, 1024)
vis.SetChaseCamera(trackPoint, 6.0, 0.5)
vis.Initialize()

vis.AddLightDirectional()
vis.AddSkyBox()
vis.AttachVehicle(vehicle.GetVehicle())

# Set the time response for steering and throttle keyboard inputs.
steering_time = 1.0  # time to go from 0 to +1 (or from 0 to -1)
throttle_time = 1.0  # time to go from 0 to +1
braking_time = 0.3   # time to go from 0 to +1
driver.SetSteeringDelta(render_step_size / steering_time)
driver.SetThrottleDelta(render_step_size / throttle_time)
driver.SetBrakingDelta(render_step_size / braking_time)

driver.Initialize()

# output vehicle mass
print( "VEHICLE MASS: ",  vehicle.GetVehicle().GetMass())

# Number of simulation steps between miscellaneous events
render_steps = math.ceil(render_step_size / step_size)

# Initialize simulation frame counter s
realtime_timer = chrono.ChRealtimeStepTimer()
step_number = 0
render_frame = 0

while vis.Run() :
    time = vehicle.GetSystem().GetChTime()

    # Render scene and output POV-Ray data
    if (step_number % render_steps == 0) :
        vis.BeginScene()
        vis.Render()
        vis.EndScene()
        render_frame += 1

    driver_inputs = driver.GetInputs()

    # Update modules (process inputs from other modules)
    driver.Synchronize(time)
    terrain.Synchronize(time)
    vehicle.Synchronize(time, driver_inputs, terrain)
    vis.Synchronize(time, driver_inputs)

    # Advance simulation for one timestep for all modules
    driver.Advance(step_size)
    terrain.Advance(step_size)
    vehicle.Advance(step_size)
    vis.Advance(step_size)

    # Increment frame number
    step_number += 1

    # Spin in place for real time to catch up
    realtime_timer.Spin(step_size)

import pychrono as chrono
import pychrono.irrlicht as irr
import pychrono.vehicle as veh

# Initialize PyChrono environment and core components
chrono.ChEngine.Initialize()

# Create the Irrlicht application
app = irr.ChIrrApp()

# Create a HMMWV vehicle with default parameters
vehicle = veh.ChHMMWV()

# Set vehicle location and orientation
vehicle.SetChassisPos(chrono.ChVectorD(0, 0, 1.0))
vehicle.SetChassisRot(chrono.ChQuaternionD(0, 0, 0, 1))

# Set contact method and TMEASY tire model
vehicle.SetContactMethod(veh.ChContactMethod_TM)
vehicle.SetTireModel(veh.ChTireModel_TMEASY)

# Enable primitive visualization for vehicle components
vehicle.SetVisualization(veh.ChVisualization_Primitives)

# Create a rigid terrain with defined dimensions and texture
terrain = veh.ChRigidTerrain(vehicle.GetSystem())
terrain.SetTerrainSize(200, 200)
terrain.SetSampleDensity(1)
terrain.SetKinematicFriction(0.9)
terrain.SetRestitutionCoeff(0.3)
terrain.AddTerrainPatch(chrono.ChVectorD(-100, -100, 0), chrono.ChVectorD(100, 100), chrono.ChVectorD(0, 0, -1))

# Load texture for terrain
terrain_mat = chrono.ChMaterialSurfaceNSC()
terrain_mat.SetTexture(chrono.ChTexture("textures/terrain.jpg"))

# Create an interactive driver system
driver = veh.ChInteractiveDriverIRR(vehicle, app.GetDevice())

# Set up driver inputs
driver.SetThrottleMax(1.0)
driver.SetSteeringMax(1.0)
driver.SetBrakingMax(1.0)

# Create the simulation system and add all components
system = vehicle.GetSystem()

# Add terrain to the system
system.Add(terrain.GetTerrainBody())
system.Add(terrain_mat)

# Set simulation parameters
system.SetGravitationalAcceleration(chrono.ChVectorD(0, 0, -9.81))
system.SetSolverType(chrono.ChSolverType_PCG)
system.SetSolverMaxIterations(100)

# Set visualization parameters
app.SetTimestep(0.02)
app.SetSimulationRate(50)

# Run the simulation
while app.Run():
    system.DoStepDynamics(0.02)
    app.Render()
    driver.Update()
